note: Permission gates for the historical importer, enforced by scripts/history/lib/permissions.mjs. Each source has a separate grant per use (fetch_targeted, fetch_bulk, process_local, publish_repository, publish_site); a host on this list is not a permission. States: CLEARED (the license permits it), LIMITED (only inside its scope), AUTHORIZED (only with a documented authorization on file: reference, grantor, dates, scope, uses and the document with its SHA-256), PENDING (a person must decide; refused) and PROHIBITED (refused). Grants are human decisions recorded here after review; tooling never changes them. A source whose review_due date has passed is refused until it is reviewed again. historical_before: records of years before it are 'historical'; on hosted they need every source catalogued and granting publish_site (requireHostedPublication). Governance by URL (governs_hosts, governs_url_patterns) applies whatever source key a batch uses, so aliases cannot bypass a grant. On hosted every cited source must be catalogued (fail closed) and every catalog entry matching it by key or URL must grant publish_site; required_source_type restricts a key-prefix match to sources declaring that type.

authorization_template.reference: e.g. MLBAM letter or contract number
authorization_template.granted_by: name and role at the rights holder
authorization_template.document: path in the repository or a private location, e.g. docs/authorizations/<file>

sources.title: MLB Stats API (draft endpoint for all amateur phases since 1965; also people, stats and transactions)
does_not_supply: the club's name in that year (team names are current)

license.name: MLBAM terms of use (contractual; no open license)

sources.terms: Responses carry: 'Use of any content on this page acknowledges agreement to the terms posted here http://gdx.mlb.com/components/copyright.txt'. Those terms: 'Only individual, non-commercial, non-bulk use of the Materials is permitted and any other use of the Materials is prohibited without prior written authorization from MLBAM.'

review.reviewed_by: BAI maintainer (Phase 9.3 authorization to tighten pending permissions)

fetch_targeted.basis: The terms permit only individual, non-commercial, non-bulk use without written MLBAM authorization. No decision yet on whether BAI's per-class research requests qualify: every downloader that reaches statsapi.mlb.com (the history importer, scripts/research/sources/fetch-mlb-player-outcomes.mjs) is refused until a person records one.

fetch_bulk.basis: League-wide, multi-year collection (about 200 requests, roughly 78,000 selections) is plausibly bulk use under the terms. Requires written MLBAM authorization recorded under authorization.

process_local.basis: Already-cached pilot files (10 requests made on 2026-10-21, before this gate existed) may be processed locally to preserve and review the pilot evidence. No other years.

publish_repository.basis: The public repository is redistribution. Selection lists, extracts and per-year counts derived from the feed stay out of Git (kept in .restricted/, backed up outside the repository).

publish_site.basis: No approved basis for publishing new MLB-sourced records (MLBAM terms: individual, non-commercial, non-bulk use without written authorization). Records already on hosted are preserved, unchanged, for the rights review (docs/history/hosted-provenance.md); "under review" is not permission for new publication. Covers the Stats API, transaction wire and MLB.com/MiLB.com pages.

sources.permission_notes: BAI has used this endpoint for every class so far (LAD 2015-2019, Wave 2 2016) at one request per class. The pilot (1965, 1985, 2005: 10 requests) stays within that pattern. A 1965-2026 league-wide backfill (about 200 requests, roughly 100,000 selections republished on a public site) is plausibly 'bulk use'. Draft facts themselves are facts, but the terms are contractual. Before any mass import a person should decide: request written authorization from MLBAM, or limit BAI's use. Recorded here, not decided.
sources.prior_use: Targeted per-class requests by the research pipeline (not this importer) for LAD 2015-2019, the six Wave 2 clubs in 2016 and international lists; those records are on hosted and in research/imports. See docs/history/hosted-provenance.md.

sources.title: Chadwick Baseball Bureau Register (people crosswalk)
supplies: MLBAM -> Baseball-Reference, Baseball-Reference minors, FanGraphs, Retrosheet ids

license.name: Open Data Commons Attribution License 1.0
license.attribution: Chadwick Baseball Bureau (cite on public pages that show ids from the register)

sources.terms: Open Data Commons Attribution License 1.0 (README, pinned commit).

review.reviewed_by: BAI maintainer (Phase 9.3 authorization to tighten pending permissions)

fetch_targeted.basis: ODC-BY permits copying; the 16 shards of one pinned commit.

fetch_bulk.basis: ODC-BY permits copying the whole register; pinned to one commit, budgeted and rate-limited.

publish_repository.basis: ODC-BY permits redistribution with attribution. BAI commits only ids attached to its own records, never the register files.

publish_site.basis: ODC-BY with attribution on pages that show the ids.

sources.permission_notes: Attribution required: cite the Chadwick Baseball Bureau on public pages that show ids from it. Pinned to one commit so replays are deterministic.

sources.title: Wikipedia: '<year> Major League Baseball draft' articles

license.name: CC BY-SA 4.0 (text); facts are not copyrightable
license.attribution: Wikipedia contributors, with the revision id

sources.terms: Text under CC BY-SA 4.0; BAI records facts (dates, counts) with the revision id, not article text.

review.reviewed_by: BAI maintainer (Phase 9.3 authorization to tighten pending permissions)

fetch_targeted.basis: One article revision per draft year through the public API, with a descriptive User-Agent.

fetch_bulk.basis: At most one article per draft year (62 for 1965-2026) per run.

process_local.basis: Facts (dates, stated totals) with the revision id.

publish_repository.basis: Facts with the revision id; short attributed quotations only, never article text.

sources.permission_notes: Independent of MLB's feed for counts and dates. A secondary source: a disagreement with MLB is recorded, never resolved by preferring either.

sources.title: Baseball-Reference pages (live, and read through Internet Archive captures)
sources.publisher: Sports Reference LLC (via the Internet Archive)
supplies: per-club selection counts and names (count corroboration)
signing flag and bonus for later years

license.name: Sports Reference terms of use (no open license); Internet Archive terms for the captures
license.attribution: Baseball-Reference.com (Sports Reference LLC), via the Internet Archive

sources.terms: Sports Reference restricts automated collection from its own site; BAI reads only archived captures, a handful of pages per draft, for corroboration.

review.reviewed_by: BAI maintainer (Phase 9.3 authorization to tighten pending permissions)

fetch_targeted.basis: Sports Reference restricts automated collection of its data; reading its pages through archive captures does not change whose data it is. Every downloader (the history importer, scripts/research/sources/fetch-bref-player-pages.mjs) is refused until a person decides.

fetch_bulk.basis: A league-wide crawl of archived Baseball-Reference pages is not permitted by its terms and is not polite to the Internet Archive (HTTP 429 seen 2026-10-21).

process_local.basis: Already-cached pilot captures may be read locally to preserve the pilot's corroboration and its exception evidence. No other years.

publish_repository.basis: Names, counts or extracts from Baseball-Reference pages are not committed to the public repository.

publish_site.basis: No approved basis for publishing new Baseball-Reference-sourced records (Sports Reference restricts reuse). Existing hosted observations, signing bonuses and WAR are preserved, unchanged, for the rights review; nothing new is published.

sources.permission_notes: Used for count corroboration in earlier phases (LAD, Wave 2). Not a bulk source: a league-wide crawl of archived pages is neither polite nor within the spirit of the terms. The Internet Archive also rate-limits (HTTP 429 seen 2026-10-21).

sources.title: BAI reference compilations and researcher determinations (franchise histories, calendars, classifications)

license.name: BAI original work (facts compiled from cited public sources)

sources.terms: BAI's own compilation. Its URL, if any, is still governed by the source it points at (an mlb.com page is governed by the MLB entry), so a BAI label cannot carry another source's data.

review.reviewed_by: BAI maintainer (Phase 9.3 authorization to tighten pending permissions)

publish_site.basis: BAI original work; any cited URL must also be permitted.

sources.title: Fictional verification fixtures (hosted:verify, inside rolled-back transactions)
sources.terms: Fictional records that exist only inside the hosted verification suite's rolled-back transactions. On hosted, the database guard (025) refuses them unless the same transaction records an explicit publication grant, which the suite does and rolls back.

review.reviewed_by: BAI maintainer (Phase 9.3 authorization to tighten pending permissions)

publish_site.basis: Rolled-back verification only; refused by the database guard outside an explicit grant.

sources.title: Retrosheet transactions database (draft and signing records)
supplies: draft year, club, draft type (secondary/active/Legion/Dominican), round, first-round pick number
'drafted, did not sign' (Dn) and signing date (Da) observations
does_not_supply: a complete draft population: only people Retrosheet tracks, mostly those who reached the majors (about 140-250 records a year, 1965-2021, almost none after 2018)

license.name: Retrosheet notice: free to make any desired use, including selling it, provided the attribution statement appears prominently
license.attribution: The information used here was obtained free of charge from and is copyrighted by Retrosheet. Interested parties may contact Retrosheet at "www.retrosheet.org".

sources.terms: https://www.retrosheet.org/notice.txt (read 2026-10-21): recipients may make any desired use, including selling the data or building a commercial product, if the attribution statement appears prominently. No accuracy guarantee. Fetch only /transactions/tranDB.zip and /transactions/readme.txt (one file, about 1.2 MB, last modified 2022-05-09); never crawl the site.

review.reviewed_by: BAI maintainer (Phase 10.1 spec: Retrosheet and Wikidata integration; terms read from the published notice and Wikidata's CC0 statement)

fetch_targeted.basis: The notice permits any use; BAI fetches the one published transactions file and its readme.

fetch_bulk.basis: The same single file; cached, checksummed in research/history/manifest.json and never re-downloaded while the cache is valid.

publish_repository.basis: Facts attached to BAI's own records, with the attribution statement. The raw file stays in the gitignored cache.

publish_site.basis: The licence permits it, but its condition (the attribution statement shown prominently) has no public surface yet and hosted has no Retrosheet attribution category (the 025 guard would refuse these records). A person grants this after the /sources credit and a migration exist.

sources.permission_notes: Attribution statement is mandatory wherever Retrosheet-derived records are shown (see license.attribution). A Retrosheet record is evidence that a person was drafted; its absence is not evidence that a person was not. Never treat it as the draft population.

sources.title: Wikidata (identity and biographical reference)
supplies: birth date and place, external ids (Baseball-Reference, MLB, Retrosheet)
a 'draft pick' statement for about 400 people
does_not_supply: a draft census (well under 1% of selections carry a draft statement)

license.name: CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication)
license.attribution: Not required; BAI credits Wikidata as a courtesy.

sources.terms: Wikidata structured data is CC0 (Wikidata:Licensing). Access follows the Wikimedia API and User-Agent policies: a descriptive agent with a project URL (never a person's email), serial requests and caching.

review.reviewed_by: BAI maintainer (Phase 10.1 spec: Retrosheet and Wikidata integration; terms read from the published notice and Wikidata's CC0 statement)

fetch_targeted.basis: CC0; one entity or one query per request, serial, with the project User-Agent.

fetch_bulk.basis: At most one request every 1.5 s and 80 requests per run; cached.

publish_repository.basis: CC0; BAI commits only Q-ids attached to its own records.

publish_site.basis: CC0 permits it, but hosted has no Wikidata attribution category yet (the 025 guard refuses these records) and no public credit surface. A person grants this with the migration that adds it.

sources.permission_notes: Secondary identity reference. A Wikidata match, or a missing one, never establishes membership of the draft population and never decides an ambiguous identity by itself.
